title: Jeffery Simmons: T'Vondre Sweat trade was a surprise to me

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jeffery Simmons: T'Vondre Sweat trade was a surprise to me
sources.description: Titans defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons has seen a lot of players come and go since joining the team in 2019 and one of this offseason's departures hit him with particularly strong force.
